analysis.title: Key Reversal Day for Bonds
key_insights: 30-year Treasury yields made a new high overnight by less than 1bp, then reversed to trade red and below the prior day's lows, a key reversal day. BTIG says risk/reward for tactical trades is now firmly toward lower yields.
BTIG does not view this as the end of the cycle for yields. The call is for a tactical pullback over the coming weeks.

A widely read publication ran a cover titled 'Will bonds blow up?'. BTIG notes the publication has a history of publishing covers well after a move is underway and treats it as a contrarian sentiment signal.
The consensus view is that lower yields are bullish for stocks. BTIG agrees for small-caps (IWM) and equal-weight (RSP), which were hurt by the rise in yields.
BTIG finds it odd that semis or QQQ would benefit from lower yields, since they were immune to the rise in rates.
BTIG calls the pain trade lower rates alongside lower SMH, QQQ and XLK.
The RTY/NDX ratio had the 8th lowest RSI on record back to 1985 (12.77). Lower yields should support the ratio, but BTIG is unsure whether it gets there through RTY rising or NDX falling.

RTY is down about 10% from its highs and at its 200-day moving average, which more often than not leads to a bounce, so BTIG would not fight it. BTIG has more conviction that NDX moves lower, a move few would expect during a bond rally.

sector_views.rationale: Semis, QQQ and XLK did not suffer in the rise in yields, so BTIG sees no reason for them to gain from lower yields. It sees them as vulnerable to a pullback in a bond rally.
IWM and RSP were punished by higher yields and could bounce on lower yields. RTY is at its 200-day moving average after a roughly 10% drawdown.

tension_points.bull_case: Consensus view: a pullback in yields is bullish for stocks, particularly small-caps (IWM) and equal-weight (RSP), which were punished by the surge in yields.
tension_points.bear_case: Semis and QQQ were immune to the rise in rates, so lower yields give them no obvious boost. BTIG sees the pain trade as lower rates with lower SMH, QQQ and XLK, and has more conviction that NDX moves lower.
tension_points.what_invalidates: A new high in 30-year yields would undercut the key reversal call (implied by the reversal below yesterday's lows).
